We need answer Chinese economics multiple choice. Need solve. User asks: if price falls 10%, money expenditure on good increases 5%, demand price elasticity in this area is? Options: A elastic, B perfectly inelastic, C inelastic but not perfectly, D unit elastic.

Need reason. Price elasticity of demand = % change Q / % change P (absolute). Expenditure = P*Q. If P falls 10%, expenditure increases 5%. Let initial P=100, Q=100, expenditure=10000. New P=90. New expenditure=10500, Q=10500/90=116.666..., %Q increase =16.666...%. %P decrease = -10%. Elasticity = 16.666/10 = 1.667 >1, elastic. Or using relationship: total revenue changes same direction as price? If price falls and total expenditure rises, demand is elastic (because quantity increase proportionally more than price decrease). So A.
Need final line exactly 答案：A. Provide concise explanation in Chinese likely. Ensure final line format.
content:
价格下降导致该商品的货币支出（总需求金额）增加，说明需求量的增加幅度大于价格下降幅度，因此该区域的需求价格弹性大于1，即富有弹性。

答案：A
